title: Entity Batch Splitter
text: Split batch entities, 1 input, 5 outputs, {Event actions} sets the event action; {Number of entities arrived, a} sets the outputs the number of entities that have arrived, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities remaining to depart, rem} sets the outputs the number of entities that remain and {Pending entity in block, pe} sets the pending entities. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: port_1
ports.summary: Input batch entity scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: port_d
ports.summary: Number of entities that have departed the block scalar

ports.name: port_rem
ports.summary: Number of entities remaining in the block scalar

ports.name: port_pe
ports.summary: Pending entity in block off (default) | on

params.name: Event actions
params.values: Specify the event action Entry (default) | Unbatch | Exit | Blocked

params.name: Number of entities arrived, a
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have arrived at the block off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities departed, d
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities remaining to depart, rem
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that remain in the block off (default) | on
